property_summary: A wallet address can never wager more than once in the reference contract because `wagers[msg.sender] == 0` enforces a single wager per address, but the bug allows an address with an existing wager to wager again, breaking the invariant that `hasPlayerWagered(actor)` still reflects exactly one wager's worth and that the second wager's amount is accepted instead of rejected.
change_summary: Changed the duplicate-wager guard to allow any existing wager value instead of only zero.
